caption: The video captures a close-up, centered view of a transparent stemmed wine glass set against a flat, uniform pale-gray background. A thin, continuous stream of clear liquid descends from above into the bowl, striking the surface and forming a small splash crown at the point of impact. The glass already holds a partial volume of aerated, bubble-filled water, and the stream is already falling into it. As the action continues, the standing water level rises gradually from the lower portion of the bowl toward the mid-bowl. The incoming stream stays present and roughly constant in position and angle, its bright highlight wobbling slightly as it falls. The liquid surface continuously deforms, with waves and the crown reshaping and sloshing from side to side. The dense field of bubbles churns and redistributes under the agitation of the pour. Throughout, the glass outline and the gray background appear stable, while the rising liquid and surface turbulence carry the motion.
